Welcome to Project Blue Lock!

Are you ready to test your skills and compete in the most intense and thrilling soccer challenges? In here you’re part of a revolutionary training program designed to find the world's best striker. Compete in fast-paced soccer matches, improve your skills, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate goal-scorer!

⚽ Features:

Compete in a challenging 5v5 match
Unlock unique character skins, abilities, and more
Will you make it to the top of Blue Lock and claim the title of the ultimate striker? Show your skills, dominate the field, and become the legend you’re destined to be!

⚙️ Controls:

W, A, S, D – Move your player around
Spacebar – Jump
Shift – Sprint 
G – Awaken
Q – Request Ball
LMB – Shoot/Pass
E - Tackle
F - Dribble

JOIN THE GROUP FOR CODES!
